tenderSchedule.description: Annual Maintenance of Madras Cannanur Road to join Balamuri Road Ch-0.00km to 4.54km(SPT-217) in Srirangapatna Taluk for the year 2026-27

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The tenderer shall furnish last five years Amount Rs.2.54 Lakhs financial turnover, profit and loss account statement i.e., from 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 from the authorized C.A. (Achieved in at least one financial year a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) (usually not less than the estimated annual payments under this contract)) With UDIN No

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Contractors should be registered as KPWD Class IV & above Civil Contractor
Assessed Tender Capacity shall be more than the Tendered Amount Rs.2.54 Lakhs

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Annual Maintenance of Madras Cannanur Road to join Balamuri Road Ch-0.00km to 4.54km(SPT-217) in Srirangapatna Taluk for the year 2026-27

itemList.description: Clearing  &  grubbing  road  land  including  vegetation,  bushes, shrubs, saplings by using weed cutter / minor equipment. ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -3- EARTH WORK, EROSION CONTROL AND DRAINAGE
itemList.description: Compacting Original Ground - Compacting original ground supporting embankment - Loosening, leveling  and Compacting original ground supporting embankment to facilitate placement of first layer of embankment, scarified to a depth of 150 mm, mixed with water at OMC and then compacted  by  rolling  so  as  to  achieve  minimum  dry  density  as given in Table 300-2 for embankment construction. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 305.3.4 ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Water Bound Macadam - Providing, laying, spreading and compacting stone aggregates of specific  sizes  to  water  bound  macadam  specification  including spreading   in   uniform   thickness,   hand   packing,   rolling   with vibratory roller in stages to proper grade and camber, applying and brooming requisite type of screening/ binding Materials to fill up the interstices of coarse aggregate, watering and compacting to the required density. - Mechanical means - Grading-I (63 mm to 45 mm) - Using Screening  Crushable type such as Moorum or Gravel. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 404 ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Water Bound Macadam - Providing, laying, spreading and compacting stone aggregates of specific  sizes  to  water  bound  macadam  specification  including spreading   in   uniform   thickness,   hand   packing,   rolling   with vibratory roller in stages to proper grade and camber, applying and brooming requisite type of screening/ binding Materials to fill up the interstices of coarse aggregate, watering and compacting to the required density. - Mechanical means - Grading-II (53 mm to 22.4 mm) - Using Screening  Crushable type such as Moorum or Gravel. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 404 ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Drains - The maintenance of drains include erosion, repair, clearing, cleaning,  reshaping,  regrading,  deepening  of  side  drains as well as catch water drains as per technical specification Clause 1908. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1908 ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

Maintenance of Earthen Shoulder (filling with fresh soil) - Making  up  loss  of  material/  irregularities  on  shoulder  to  the design level by adding fresh approved soil and compacting it with appropriate equipment.Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003 ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work

Patching of Potholes - Patching of Shallow Potholes using SDBC Gr II 25 mm thick - Patching  of  shallow  potholes  on  asphalt  surfaces  by  using Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete 25mm thickness. The Cost is inclusive of removing the failed materials & cleaning on the road surface, preparation of potholes to the required standards sizes before patching them and application of tack coat at 0.20 kg/ m2 over the asphalt surface including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification. ---- All items in the tender include cost of hire charges of machineries and equipments with all lead, lift, supply and erection and labour charges, complete as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work
